proposals.action_title: Upload 50 Minimalist Text-Based Designs on Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Bypasses the current AI image generation bottleneck completely. Text-only designs (funny developer quotes, niche professions, regional slang) require only Python/ImageMagick in Termux to generate transparent PNGs. High organic search volume on Redbubble.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a quick Python script on Termux to combine a list of 50 funny developer/entrepreneur quotes with a clean typography template and output transparent PNGs.

proposals.action_title: Publish First KDP Coloring Book Using Together AI (FLUX-schnell)
proposals.why_this_works_now: Together AI offers a generous free tier for FLUX-schnell. FLUX is excellent at line art. Generating 30 high-quality coloring pages for a specific micro-niche (e.g., 'Retro Future Vehicles' or 'Cute Axolotls') will launch the first KDP asset.
proposals.first_action_today: Set up a free Together AI account, grab the API key, and test a single curl command from Termux to generate a black-and-white vector-style coloring page.

proposals.action_title: Upload 3 Parametric OpenSCAD Utility Models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: 3D printing hobbyists love customizability. OpenSCAD files (like parametric grid wall hooks or drawer dividers) do not require AI image generation. Renderings can be automatically generated via OpenSCAD CLI on GitHub Actions.
proposals.first_action_today: Write or adapt a simple parametric drawer organizer script in OpenSCAD, and test-compile it to STL via GitHub Actions.

proposals.action_title: Repackage Coloring Book as Digital PDF on Gumroad + Pinterest Auto-Pin
proposals.why_this_works_now: KDP physical book buyers are different from digital buyers. Selling the exact same coloring book pages as a printable PDF on Gumroad/Lemonsqueezy allows global access instantly. Traffic can be driven for free via automated Pinterest pins using GitHub Actions.
proposals.first_action_today: Create a free Gumroad account and draft a product listing template for 'Printable Coloring Book PDF'.

proposals.action_title: Publish 10 Ultra-Niche KDP Lined Journals with Minimalist Cover Art
proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content journals require zero complex interior formatting (just repeating lined pages). By using simple, high-contrast geometric cover art (easy to generate on Cloudflare Workers AI free tier or Together AI), Hugo can target 10 specific sub-hobbies in minutes.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 10 PDF interiors (standard 6x9, 120 pages) using a basic Python PDF generation script on Termux.
